name: Shower Waterproofing: The Layer That Decides Whether Your Tile Lasts
title-tag: Tile Shower Waterproofing Done Right | Redmond, WA
meta-description: Tile shower waterproofing explained layer by layer: pre-slope, bonded membrane vs liquid, the 24-hour flood test, and why grout was never waterproof.
post-summary: October 27, 2026 · Tile and grout are the wear surface of a shower, not the waterproofing. Here is the full assembly that actually keeps water out of your walls - pre-slope, bonded membrane, sealed corners, drain integration - plus the difference between sheet and liquid systems, and why every pan we build in Redmond sits under a photographed 24-hour flood test before tile goes on.
